description.title: A flight reserved for your group
description.paragraph: Enjoy the Teotihuacán Valley on a private flight with a coffee break, insurance, a champagne toast, certificate and full breakfast. Transport, photos and ground visits are quoted as extras. Confirm how many guests the package includes.

steps.title: Arrival and coffee break
steps.description: The team welcomes you for check-in and a coffee break. Confirm your meeting point.

steps.title: Getting ready to fly
steps.description: The team briefs you on boarding and enjoying the experience safely.

steps.title: Private flight
steps.description: See the Teotihuacán Valley from the balloon. The route depends on the day’s conditions.

steps.title: Full breakfast
steps.description: Enjoy this included service: full breakfast. Confirm its timing and place in your itinerary.

recommendedExtras: Private round-trip transport for two guests in the central area
notes: Confirm availability, timing, the meeting point and your total before booking.
Flight duration, route and activity order are confirmed according to weather and operating conditions.
Extras are quoted separately; confirm their scope, price and availability.
Confirm how many guests the package includes, the booking minimum and charges for additional passengers or companions.
